summary: Pinned and materialized full Greek Enneads V.4 (chapters1–2), read whole for five V.4.1 readings and one V.4.2 Intellect reading. Six prose readings preserve first-principle self-standing/global scope, constitutive need for internal simples, asserted uniqueness, body exclusion, Intellect plurality and immediate-or-mediated derivation. Exact FirstMoverSimple.firstMoverSimple, StageTwo.GodIsSimple.godIsSimple and SourceForest.atMostOne_of_confluent/rooted_of_confluent were inspected and reused as conditional boundaries, not relabeled Plotinian results. A duplicate graph/simplicity theorem and a transcription of uniqueness were rejected: needed interpretation and individuation premises remain independent. Distinct numerical individuals each lacking modeled components are not refuted by saying their pair is not one; actual causal correspondence and common-domain coverage also remain open. Positive rival map and source/proof boundaries are in docs/notes/plotinian-composition-unity.md. No new Lean/result, no root premise or route change. PR665 review correctly identified that the Intellect/intelligible argument belongs to V.4.2: the pinned XML section2 starts with εἰ μὲν οὖν αὐτονοῦς before διὰ τί δὲ οὐ νοῦς. Corrected the locator and dependent scope descriptions; the complete-treatise witness and philosophical commitments are unchanged. Successor reading completed2026-10-31: pinned/materialized/read Greek VI.9.1–6 as six complete chapter witnesses PLOTINUS-ENN-VI-9-1 through-6 in the SAME First1K revision/blob. Sequential source map preserves identity-through-unity examples; soul multiple powers and derivative unity; Intellect/Form/comprehensive intelligible-Being multiplicity and constituent priority; beyond-form generative-first account; contemplative-presence limits; explicit nonbodily-soul/intellect audience presuppositions; and VI9.6 positive constituent-need/self-sufficiency argument with nonquantitative power-infinity. Strongest plural reply grants organized/intelligible multiplicity needs unity but denies that EACH of two intrinsically simple whole natures becomes internally multiple because their pair is plural. No independent new numerical-individuation step found for that case; universal One-source participation remains a substantive ontology rather than consequence of sharing the predicate one. Plotinian intelligible Being is not broad ExistsAt; beyondBeing does not mean literal nonexistence. Ontic firstness, common generative coverage, modal necessity and Catholic identification remain distinct. Full precise scope and rejected readings persist in docs/notes/plotinian-composition-unity.md; no new claims, predicates, Lean theorem/model or philosophical premise. Existing candidate PLOTINIAN-DEPENDENCE-UNIQUENESS-BRIDGES removed because its prescribed V4/VI9.1–6 ranges are exhausted, not kept as gap tracker. No arbitrary successor: source-choice gap is a primary independently defended numerical-common-source/second-simple-individuation argument; VI9.7–11 remains unread and is not cited or automatically queued. Root premise delta zero.
blocker: Interpret the source constituent-need and power/form plurality in the same selected composition/priority domain, and independently justify common numerical source coverage against plural intrinsic simple whole natures. The VI9.1–6 reading is now complete; its hierarchy/self-sufficiency argument does not by itself show that each of two such candidates is internally many. No precise next primary witness for that missing individuation/coverage bridge has been selected; unread VI9.7–11 is not evidence. Modal necessity, all-world support independence and Catholic identification remain separate.
